notes.title: Changes made to Levels 1 & 2
notes.notes: Optimization patches and overall gameplay updates that allow for smoother gameplay.

notes.title: Bug fixes and patches to be released soon.
notes.notes:
We have made changes to Finding Ice in order to make gameplay more smooth. General bug fixes will be released soon - these are not graphical changes and are primarily designed to make gameplay easier and smoother - improving the overall experience of the game.

Grab Finding Ice at 55% off for World Animal Day, ending on the 14th of October 2022.
